rows.medi_said: سـ... تلات إلا نـ... إلا تلت.

rows.medi_said: مهندس-- Do you guys say مهندس كهرباء؟

rows.medi_said: كراجي. See, This is a new word.

rows.medi_said: ما، ما يكون، uh, كهربج-- لا، أه، كهربجي، هو مهندس
rows.why: 'He is not an electrician, he is an engineer' in the plain present takes مش before the noun, no ykoon; Amal let it pass.
rows.english: he isn't an electrician, he's an engineer

rows.medi_said: صـ صلح، صلحني شوي. ... صلاحلي, helps to me, شوي.
rows.amal_said: صلح لي. ... صلحني would be he fixed me. Like you, you were who's being fixed. ... Fixed for me، صلح لي.
rows.why: He put the object ending on the verb (he fixed ME); Amal explained the ending makes him the thing fixed and gave صلح لي (fixed for me).
rows.english: he fixed (it) for me a bit

rows.amal_said: You said صلح which is fix. You did wha-- did you wanna say he helped me? ... ساعدني.
rows.why: He meant 'he helped me' but used صلح (fix); Amal asked whether he meant helped and he produced ساعدني (sheet: help | Saa3ed | ساعد).

rows.medi_said: بلوزة، um, ورداني لأول مرة معك

rows.medi_said: اه، this is take على بيتي.

rows.medi_said: بس كلمة-- بس فعل، اه، تنين،
